criteria.description: Pins the repository revision or working-tree fingerprint and states exclusions.
Measures the source inventory without collapsing absent surfaces into guesses.
Provides deterministic targets that bind to actual repository paths.
Keeps unreadable, skipped, or unknown surfaces explicit.
Makes the next bounded Architecture Study target and reason clear.
Studies the selected map target and preserves its source binding.
Connects claims to line-addressable evidence from the pinned source.
Separates observed, inferred, unknown, and decision records.
Covers runtime, persistence, extension, security, ownership, or explicitly records unknowns.
Leaves concrete next targets for unresolved architecture questions.
